data.text: Luke, no—I won’t ask the others to join a race that could wipe out our livelihood. I support 10 tons each this month, provided all five of us agree. At that rate, you’d earn $120,000 over twelve months, compared with at most $100,000 from emptying the lake once and nothing afterward. My family taught me to fish these waters, and I want there to be something left for the village. Let’s agree before we launch, then check our disclosed catches together each month. Luke, will you withdraw your 100-ton request and accept the same 10-ton share as everyone else?
